_about: Clement Charles Julian Webb (1865-1954), Oxford philosopher of religion, Oriel Professor of the Philosophy of the Christian Religion. Raw IA OCR: Problems in the Relations of God and Man (London: Nisbet, 1911), clean 0.90; Group Theories of Religion and the Individual (London: Allen and Unwin, 1916), clean 0.92; God and Personality, Gifford Lectures first course (Allen and Unwin, this copy the June 1920 reprint), clean 0.93; Divine Personality and Human Life, Gifford Lectures second course (Allen and Unwin, 1920), clean 0.93; Kant's Philosophy of Religion (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1926), clean 0.92. Held: A History of Philosophy (Home University Library), because none of the three open scans prints a year. His church-history books (A Century of Anglican Theology, 1923; Religious Thought in the Oxford Movement, 1928) are theology and left for lane A. US public domain. No uids minted.
